milestones.goal: J1 generate-and-export works end to end on the seeded league (already built; evidence recorded here)

tasks.title: Vertical slice: results to bands to block to CSV
tasks.objective: The seeded league parses, bands, schedules four weeks and exports the uploader CSV; the workspace shows it
tasks.notes: built before pb.py init; evidence re-run after task start

tasks.title: Fresh-context review and bug hunt
tasks.objective: Six independent reviewers (contract, scheduler, UX, accessibility, submission honesty, security/deploy) with adversarial verification of every finding; findings saved to .prod-build/reports/review.md
acceptance: every blocking finding has file:line and a reproduction
verify: observe: review report saved with confirmed and refuted findings
tasks.notes: runs as a workflow; reviewers change no code

tasks.title: Fix confirmed review findings
tasks.objective: Every confirmed blocking or major finding fixed through a failing test where a rule is involved, minor ones logged
tasks.notes: qa/shots.py needs a preview server on 4173; run it through pb.py run with the server started in the background

tasks.title: Deploy verification on the live URL
tasks.objective: Smoke and the demo flow three times on the deployed site, logged out, with a reset between runs
verify: observe: demo flow J1 completed 3 times on the live URL with no console errors

tasks.title: Demo video
tasks.objective: A narrated demo under three minutes recorded from the live URL, passing the kit's QA gate (length, no narration gaps, no static picture over 3.5 s, loudness, ASR coverage)
acceptance: Presentation: the video shows paste-free flow, move, generate, export, shortfall
verify: observe: demo-kit qa.py passed and every contact sheet reviewed
tasks.notes: recorded in ../regrade-demo; final.mp4 is delivered outside the repo

tasks.title: Submission package
tasks.objective: README links, delivery report and submission facts final; every link tested logged out
acceptance: README evidence table maps all four criteria
tasks.notes:
the learner writes the Devpost copy; the video link is pasted by the learner after upload
[2026-09-27 start] T05 video still rendering; T06 gate work runs in parallel

tasks.title: Non-blocking font CSS
tasks.objective: First paint no longer waits for the Google Fonts stylesheet; LCP under the 2.5 s budget on Lighthouse's throttled mobile profile (measured 2.7 s before, E0043)
acceptance: LCP <= 2.5 s on the live URL, Lighthouse mobile default
verify: observe: Lighthouse on the live URL after deploy shows LCP at or under 2.5 s with accessibility 100
tasks.notes:
added after measuring; plan changed openly
[2026-09-27 skip] measured worse: CLS 0.71 with non-blocking fonts (E0045); reverted; LCP 2.7 s stays on throttled mobile, desktop measured separately

tasks.title: Self-host the three fonts and preload the critical two
tasks.objective: Remove the web-font swap shift (desktop CLS 0.854, E0047) and the third-party font round trips; keep the design identical
acceptance: desktop and mobile CLS < 0.1 on the live URL
verify: observe: Lighthouse desktop and mobile on the live URL after deploy show CLS under 0.1 and accessibility 100
tasks.notes: T07 (non-blocking CSS) made CLS worse and was reverted; this removes the cause instead

tasks.title: Host on Vercel with security and cache headers
tasks.objective: Move production to Vercel so a server function can exist; add security headers and immutable caching for hashed assets; keep the old Pages URL working as a redirect
acceptance: production URL on Vercel serves the app with CSP, nosniff and referrer headers
the Pages URL redirects to Vercel
verify: observe: the Vercel production URL returns the app with the security headers, and the Pages URL redirects
tasks.rollback: re-enable the Pages deploy workflow and revert vercel.json
tasks.notes: static hosting was not what limited the UI; the reason to move is the server function in T10

tasks.title: Read results in any form (AI intake with grounding and review)
tasks.objective: Paste results as free text; one structured-output model call turns lines into rows, each citing its source line; code checks every row against its line; the deterministic parser validates; the secretary reviews and loads
acceptance: rows that don't match their quoted line are dropped and listed
nothing loads without the review step
with the function unavailable the CSV path still works and the UI says so
input capped, output capped, timeout, per-instance rate limit
verify: observe: live intake of the golden messy results on the Vercel URL returns grounded rows and the review screen
tasks.rollback: AI_ENABLED=false in Vercel env (the button hides and the CSV path remains)

tasks.title: Assistant baseline: the same job given to a general model
tasks.objective: Measure whether pasting the sample results and slots into a strong general model gets a usable block, by recounting its CSV with the validate rules
acceptance: the exact prompt, model and raw output are saved
the recount is the same code as validate
the README states the result whatever it is
verify: observe: baseline run recorded with clashes, repeats, gap and missing fixtures

tasks.title: Re-record the demo from the Vercel site with the intake scene
tasks.objective: Video shows reading messy results, the review, the rest of the loop, and the new URL
acceptance: qa.py --asr passes with no frozen segments
verify: observe: demo-kit qa.py passed and every contact sheet reviewed
